environment.description: Tomcat 9.0.62 running on EC2 instance in private subnet. PostgreSQL 14.3 RDS instance with db user having SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all schemas. Application accessed via NLB (Layer 4) with no request inspection. Security group allows TCP 5432 from app subnet. No query-level firewall or statement interceptor configured on the database connection. JDBC URL uses simple connection string: jdbc:postgresql://rds-endpoint:5432/appdb

config.db_permissions: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on all tables in public schema
config.db_user_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_user
